description: Dimensioned XBRL facts for one filer — segment, geography or other axis breakdowns that data.sec.gov companyfacts/frames cannot return (those APIs expose undimensioned consolidated totals only). Give a company name (ILIKE match) or a CIK; optionally narrow to one tag (e.g. "Revenues", "LongTermDebtNoncurrent"). Returns each fact's period, value, unit, and — for a dimensioned fact — the segment/member axis it belongs to. Sourced from SEC DERA Financial Statement & Notes data sets, covering only the periods actually loaded (see fsn_coverage).

cik.description: SEC CIK, with or without leading zeros. Takes priority over company if both are given.

company.description: Company name, matched with ILIKE (e.g. "Flutter Entertainment"). Omit if passing cik.

tag.description: Exact XBRL tag name to filter to, e.g. "DerivativeNotionalAmount" (case-sensitive).
